name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall ceiling, immediately backroll wet film to work primer into mud joints. Cut in the wall line with brush after the spray pass to clean up overspray on the masking tape. NC ceiling production standard.
doctrine: Spray + backroll + post-spray tape cleanup. Universal field tasks (TSK_SPRAY_CEILING_FINISH 450, TSK_BACKROLL_CEILING_FINISH 320) reused for prime; TRADE_MATERIAL fires (eligibility.material:true) → WB_PRIMER 1.25× time multiplier. Cut-in cleanup (TSK_CEIL_CUT_IN_WALL_SPRAY_PRIME) is prime-specific brush work after the spray pass to clean overspray on tape.
